findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the coordinator compares repair rounds after release.
The item 1 proof still checks only the recorded effort. Its resuming stand-in emits no token-usage notifications (tests/test_codex_resume.py:127–152), and the test checks neither a before-and-after comparison by item kind nor a report. The new proof-list note schedules the coordinator's work but provides no separate proof that the comparison and report happen. This test therefore passes even if the promised measurement and report never happen.
